notes: PIPELINE-VALIDATION FIXTURE, not a representative modern-print quality bar. Born-digital PDF rendered via PyMuPDF `Story` (the only renderer available here; LibreOffice is broken on this host). pymupdf4llm on Story-rendered PDFs exhibits two real but synthetic-triggered fidelity gaps it likely wouldn't on InDesign/LaTeX/Word output: (1) it drops the first paragraph after some headings (drives WER), (2) it flattens the H1/H3 to H2 and wraps headings in `**bold**` (caps structural-F1 at 4/6 exact matches). Thresholds are REGRESSION gates calibrated to the measured baseline + margin, so the fixture passes today and alerts if the parser regresses. The aspirational modern-print target from docs/eval-corpus-plan.md is CER <= 0.02 — a human-curated real PDF is needed to measure against that fairly. Exercises heading hierarchy, bulleted + numbered lists, and a 3-column GFM table (the table parsed cleanly).
